title: Barbara Kruger: Believe + Doubt

description.main: The catalogue of Believe + Doubt, Barbara Kruger's 2013-14 exhibition at the Kunsthaus Bregenz, edited by Yilmaz Dziewior, with a conversation between Kruger, Beatriz Colomina and Mark Wigley.
description.extended:
This is the catalogue of Believe + Doubt, Barbara Kruger's exhibition across three floors of the Kunsthaus Bregenz from 19 October 2013 to 12 January 2014, her first major institutional solo show in Austria.

Kruger designed the show for Peter Zumthor's building. Next to photocollages from the 1980s and a four-channel video work of 2004, she showed mostly new installations made for the Kunsthaus, taking up the facade, walls, floor and ceiling in turn. The book is edited by Yilmaz Dziewior, whose introductory essay sets out the concept of the exhibition and the new work made for it. A long conversation between Kruger, the architectural historian Beatriz Colomina and the architect Mark Wigley follows. Photographic spreads, designed in close cooperation with the artist, document the installation.

The 176-page hardcover was designed by Yvonne Quirmbach, with parallel texts in German and English.
description.artist_bio: Barbara Kruger (b. 1945, Newark) is an American artist who pairs found photographs with declarative text. She worked as a designer and picture editor at Conde Nast magazines, including Mademoiselle, before turning to photocollage in the late 1970s. She received the Golden Lion for lifetime achievement at the 51st Venice Biennale in 2005.
description.exhibition_context: Kunsthaus Bregenz exhibition KUB 2013.04, designed by Kruger for the building's three floors; it combined 1980s photocollages, a four-channel video work of 2004 and new site-specific installations.

notes: Second copy of this title; the first copy is catalogue row 606. Kunsthaus Bregenz, edited by Yilmaz Dziewior, essay by Dziewior and a conversation between Beatriz Colomina, Mark Wigley and Barbara Kruger, graphic design by Yvonne Quirmbach, German and English, hardcover, 22 x 30 cm, 176 pages (Library of Congress counts 173). The Kunsthaus Bregenz shop gives the release as December 2013; library records date the book 2014 and D.A.P. released it in the US on 31 August 2014. Distributed outside Europe by D.A.P.; some listings name Verlag der Buchhandlung Walther König as publisher or distributor. The cover and exhibition page read Believe + Doubt; the Kunsthaus shop and D.A.P. list it as Belief + Doubt or Believe & Doubt. Illustration count (182 color, 19 b/w) per D.A.P.
